description: Final pipeline configuration (pipeline-v4) for any input CSV: a local router scores every distinct text; risky texts (support topic, billing/privacy/fraud terms, or severity >= 4), capped at 5% of distinct texts, are labeled by GPT-6 Luna (3 requests in flight); every other text by the sealed local classifier. Blind Luna verification of 10% of rows (10-400) stratified by label source, embedding grouping with bounded Luna naming, deterministic ranking, verifier-based sensitivity analysis when at least 30 local texts are verified, Luna memo (2-request cap). Luna runs through the Codex CLI with ChatGPT subscription authentication.
